reference_provenance.note: Completed pinned offline all-process invocation; final native rerun compared against its unchanged JSON. Not a new run.py execution.

known_limitations: Pinned reference process lookup uses virtual mapping-start page keys and physical-start values; kernel members retain the contiguous mapping virtual start for every backing page. These reference behaviors are intentionally preserved.
Pinned reference ignores backing-layer identity, including pagefile offsets; attribution is not proof of a physically resident owner.
FREE MEMORY means no owner in readable mappings, not proof that no owner exists. Damaged or uncaptured mappings preserve partial diagnostics.
Only local regular files up to 64 MiB, lines up to 1 MiB and 1,000,000 records/owner members are accepted; remote URI, compressed and larger input parity remains unverified.
Other kernels, real x86 inputs, pagefile recovery and complete parameter/failure contract remain unverified.
All-process reference output was reused from its completed pinned invocation; final native output was rerun and strictly compared. Other three cases were freshly run by run.py.
